title: Adaptive-threshold safeguard & canary harmonization for FP8 on Hopper (E4M3/E5M2)
creator: Avery Chen
description: Goal: Ship a robust, automated FP8 enablement flow for Hopper-class GPUs that uses adaptive thresholds and a harmonized canary process to reduce false positives and avoid unnecessary rollbacks. This ticket covers the engineering work to implement a sensitivity-based threshold layer, a canary harmonization coordinator, and deterministic rollback gates for E4M3/E5M2 quant profiles. It complements existing calibration and telemetry pipelines but focuses on smoothing activation noise during ramping and preventing spurious customer-facing degradations.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Adaptive threshold service runs during canary windows and emits pass/fail decisions with confidence bands. 2) Canary coordinator enforces minimum sample counts and cross-shard consensus before profile activation. 3) Rollback gates trigger only when both accuracy regressions (per-eval set) and production error/latency regressions exceed configured SLOs. 4) End-to-end tests and golden evals included in CI. 5) Documentation and runbook added to Confluence.
plan: - Phase 1 (this ticket): Implement adaptive-threshold microservice and API hooks for the canary coordinator. Add telemetry probes to existing eval runner. Integrate with canary job scheduler. - Phase 2: Run shadow canaries across 3 model archetypes (chat, completion, rerank) and collect 2 weeks of telemetry. - Phase 3: Turn on gradual ramp with progressive traffic splitting, monitor DRIs, and final activation with automated rollback enabled.
telemetry_checks: - Per-model per-profile accuracy delta vs baseline on seeded evals (95% CI). - Latency P95 and P99 delta. - Token-level perplexity and top-k probability shifts. - Request error rate and timeout rate by shard. - Canary consensus rate (fraction of shards agreeing).
test_plan: - Unit tests for adaptive threshold math and confidence intervals. - Integration test: simulate drift and ensure coordinator refuses activation when thresholds breached. - CI: golden-suite deterministic evaluation using 5 seeds; baseline acceptance threshold 0.5% relative accuracy regression. - Load test: ensure coordinator does not add >5ms median tail latency to request path.
rollout_strategy: 1) Dark-launch FP8 profile in shadow mode for 10% of traffic for 48 hours. 2) Canary harmonization: require >=80% shard consensus plus stable eval pass for 48 hours. 3) Progressive ramp: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% with 24-hour holds and automatic rollback on gate failure. 4) Fallback profiles: if activation fails, route to int8-safe profile for affected models.

comments: 2025-02-06 Avery Chen: Initial spike completed. Prototype adaptive-threshold math implemented (bayesian bootstrap + rolling window). Observed lower false-positive rate vs fixed-threshold in synthetic drift tests.

2025-02-10 Diego Martinez: Integrated threshold service with canary scheduler; added endpoint /evaluate_threshold that returns (decision, confidence_score, sample_count). Performance microbenchmark shows 1.8ms median, 6.7ms 99th on control node.
2025-02-12 PM review (Sofia Patel): Requested clearer rollback criteria tied to customer-facing metrics. Added requirement to include latency and error-rate gates in addition to eval accuracy.
2025-02-14 Design review (Liam O'Connor): UX for console will show canary consensus and confidence bands. Design asks for an explainer on what 'consensus' means for multi-shard deployments.

2025-02-18 Diego Martinez: Ran first shadow canary against chat-medium and rerank-small models. Eval deltas: chat-medium accuracy -0.18% (CI +/-0.12), rerank-small +0.02% (CI +/-0.08). No latency regressions observed. Added these artifacts to the dashboard.
2025-02-19 Risk note (Security): Verified no new key materials or KMS flows are required. Data retention for canary logs set to 30 days by default.
2025-02-20 Diego Martinez: Updated thresholds after analysis: tighten accuracy gate to 0.4% for chat path due to business sensitivity. Plan to start progressive ramp on 2025-02-24 if no regressions.
notes: Implementation must be idempotent and support operator override. Coordinator will expose a manual 'force-activate' and 'force-revert' flag gated by RBAC. We will run an incident simulation drill during rollout to validate human-in-loop rollback paths.
operational_runbook: - Monitor eval dashboard and canary consensus metric. - If accuracy regression > configured threshold AND P95 latency increase > 15% for two consecutive 1-hour buckets, trigger automatic rollback. - Pager duty: inference-oncall. - Postmortem: attach artifacts and trace ids to the ticket.
postrollout_tasks: - Audit telemetry to refine per-model thresholds. - Add canary harmonization metrics to per-customer cost reports. - Backfill docs for Sales/Support explaining visible behavior during ramp.
implemented_changes: - adaptive-threshold service under runtime/apis/threshold_service implemented. - coordinator hooks registered in canary scheduler. - CI golden-suite expanded with 3 new seed sets.
next_steps: 1) Complete additional shadow canaries for int8-sensitive customers. 2) Run simulated incident drill on 2025-02-22. 3) If green, start progressive ramp on 2025-02-24.
